Prism predicts — how we get these moves

Each chip is a forward-looking expected return, not a price target you set. It's generated by our narrative-forensics engine and blended with horizon-specific price models.

  • Narrative mass & drift — how entrenched the story is vs. how fast it's decaying
  • Historical analogs — outcomes for tickers with similar narrative signatures
  • Regime context — Walsh market & sector regimes that amplify or damp the signal
  • Horizon-specific forecasts — separate 5/10/20-day return models calibrated on actual price history

Day Trade uses the intraday target %. Swing & Momentum use the 5–10d forecast. Value Picks use 20d. Narrative Traps show 5d expected downside. Probabilities reflect model calibration — not certainty.

A pulsing ticker
The cyan ring means coordination score ≥ 60 — posts about this ticker are clustering unusually in time, wording, or account patterns. It doesn't mean the move is wrong; it means the attention is being organized. Treat the narrative as amplified and verify the thesis before trusting — or fading — the move.

Frequently Asked Questions
How do I cancel my subscription?
Click "Cancel Subscription" above or "Manage Subscription" to open the Stripe billing portal. From there you can cancel immediately or at the end of your billing period. You will retain access until your current period ends.
How do I upgrade or change my plan?
Click "Change Plan" above to visit the pricing page, or use "Manage Subscription" to switch plans directly through Stripe. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated.
What happens when my free trial ends?
When your 7-day trial ends, your payment method on file will be charged for the plan you selected. You can cancel anytime before the trial ends to avoid being charged.
What is included in the Standard plan?
Standard ($15/mo) includes Daily Plays, Sector Pulse, Market-Wide, Ticker Snapshots, Discover, Narrative History, and up to 3 ticker detail pages per day.
What is included in the Pro plan?
Pro ($25/mo) includes everything in Standard plus Trading Cards, Leaderboard, Trading Calendar, Trap Radar, and unlimited ticker detail pages.
Where does Market Prism get its data?
Our AI pipeline analyzes SEC EDGAR filings, real-time market data feeds, news sources, and proprietary narrative scoring models. All signals are generated by AI — no human editorial bias.
How do I update my payment method?
Click "Manage Subscription" to open the Stripe billing portal where you can update your card, view invoices, and manage payment details.
Need more help? Contact us at founder@marketprism.co
